rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person is emotionally crushed by guilt, stress, or similar feelings.

example.english: All this pressure is really starting to overwhelm me.
example.traditional: 呢排啲壓力真係壓垮我喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 di1 aat3 lik6 zan1 hai6 aat3 kwaa1 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when one side overpowers or crushes another, especially through superior force.

example.jyutping: deoi3 sau2 jyun4 cyun4 aat3 dou2 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this for water or a wave surging over something until it is completely submerged.

example.english: A single huge wave can overwhelm a car, submerging it completely.
example.traditional: 一個大浪可以浸到冇頂，成架車都唔見晒。
example.jyutping: jat1 go3 daai6 long6 ho2 ji5 zam3 dou3 mou5 deng2 seng4 gaa3 ce1 dou1 m4 gin3 saai3
